<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Crespo Fredika — Geotechnical Engineer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@400;600;700&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --cream: #F5F0E8;
    --cream-dark: #EDE6D6;
    --brown-light: #C4A882;
    --brown-mid: #8B6914;
    --brown-deep: #5C4A1E;
    --brown-dark: #3A2E12;
    --green-earth: #4A5E3A;
    --green-dark: #2E3D22;
    --green-light: #8FA87A;
    --stone: #9E9080;
    --stone-light: #D4CCC0;
    --text-dark: #2A2218;
    --text-mid: #5C5246;
    --text-light: #8C8070;
    --accent: #7A5C28;
  }

  * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--cream);
    color: var(--text-dark);
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ── NAV ── */
  nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    padding: 1.2rem 4rem;
    background: rgba(245,240,232,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
    transition: box-shadow 0.3s;
  }
  nav.scrolled { box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(58,46,18,0.08); }
  .nav-logo {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--brown-deep); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .nav-links { display: flex; gap: 2.5rem; list-style: none; }
  .nav-links a {
    text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-mid); letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover { color: var(--brown-deep); }
  .nav-toggle { display: none; cursor: pointer; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
  .nav-toggle span { display: block; width: 24px; height: 2px; background: var(--brown-deep); }

  /* ── HERO ── */
  #hero {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    padding-top: 80px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .hero-texture {
    position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
    background-image:
      radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(74,94,58,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(139,105,20,0.07) 0%, transparent 50%),
      url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg width='60' height='60' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Ccircle cx='1' cy='1' r='1' fill='%23C4A882' fill-opacity='0.15'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
  }
  .hero-left {
    padding: 5rem 3rem 5rem 4rem;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center;
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
  }
  .hero-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    background: var(--green-earth); color: var(--cream);
    font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 6px 16px; border-radius: 100px;
    margin-bottom: 2rem; width: fit-content;
  }
  .hero-badge::before {
    content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--green-light); animation: pulse 2s infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse {
    0%,100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(1.4); }
  }
  .hero-name {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 5vw, 4.2rem);
    font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1;
    color: var(--brown-dark);
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  }
  .hero-name span { color: var(--green-earth); }
  .hero-title {
    font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 300; color: var(--stone);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 1.8rem;
  }
  .hero-desc {
    font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: var(--text-mid);
    max-width: 440px; margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  }
  .hero-cta { display: flex; gap: 1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .btn-primary {
    padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
    background: var(--green-earth); color: var(--cream);
    border: none; border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn-outline {
    padding: 0.85rem 2rem;
    background: transparent; color: var(--brown-deep);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--brown-light); border-radius: 4px;
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--brown-deep); color: var(--brown-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); }

  .hero-right {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    padding: 5rem 4rem 5rem 2rem; position: relative; z-index: 1;
  }
  .hero-photo-frame {
    position: relative; width: 360px; height: 420px;
  }
  .hero-photo-bg {
    position: absolute; bottom: -16px; right: -16px;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: var(--green-earth); border-radius: 8px; opacity: 0.18;
  }
  .hero-photo-border {
    position: absolute; top: -12px; left: -12px;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    border: 2px solid var(--brown-light); border-radius: 8px;
  }
  .hero-photo {
    position: relative; z-index: 1;
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--cream-dark);
  }
  .hero-photo img {
    width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: top center;
  }
  .hero-photo-placeholder {
    width: 100%; height: 100%;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--cream-dark) 0%, var(--stone-light) 100%);
    gap: 12px;
  }
  .hero-photo-placeholder svg { opacity: 0.4; }
  .hero-photo-placeholder p {
    font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--stone); font-style: italic;
  }
  .hero-stats {
    position: absolute; bottom: -24px; left: -24px;
    background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(58,46,18,0.1);
    display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; z-index: 2;
  }
  .stat { text-align: center; }
  .stat-num {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brown-deep);
    display: block;
  }
  .stat-label { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--stone); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }

  /* ── SECTIONS ── */
  section { padding: 6rem 4rem; }
  .section-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; }
  .section-label {
    font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--green-earth);
    margin-bottom: 0.6rem; display: block;
  }
  .section-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3vw, 2.6rem);
    font-weight: 700; color: var(--brown-dark);
    line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 3rem;
  }
  .divider {
    width: 48px; height: 3px;
    background: var(--green-earth);
    margin: 0.8rem 0 3rem; border-radius: 2px;
  }

  /* ── ABOUT ── */
  #about { background: var(--cream); }
  .about-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.4fr; gap: 5rem; align-items: start; }
  .about-left { position: sticky; top: 120px; }
  .about-quote {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.4rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--brown-deep);
    border-left: 3px solid var(--green-earth);
    padding-left: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 2rem;
    font-style: italic;
  }
  .about-info { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.8rem; }
  .info-row { display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; }
  .info-label { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--stone); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; min-width: 90px; }
  .info-val { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--text-mid); }
  .about-right { }
  .about-text { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.9; color: var(--text-mid); margin-bottom: 2rem; }
  .about-highlight {
    background: var(--cream-dark); border-left: 3px solid var(--brown-light);
    padding: 1.2rem 1.5rem; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
  }
  .about-highlight p { font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--text-mid); }
  .about-highlight strong { color: var(--brown-deep); font-weight: 500; }

  /* ── SKILLS ── */
  #skills { background: var(--cream-dark); }
  .skills-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 2rem; }
  .skill-card {
    background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.8rem;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }
  .skill-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(58,46,18,0.08); }
  .skill-card-icon {
    width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 6px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: 1rem; font-size: 1.2rem;
  }
  .skill-card-icon.geo { background: rgba(74,94,58,0.12); }
  .skill-card-icon.soft { background: rgba(139,105,20,0.12); }
  .skill-card-icon.lab { background: rgba(196,168,130,0.2); }
  .skill-card h3 { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--brown-dark); margin-bottom: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
  .skill-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  .tag {
    font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 100px;
    background: var(--cream-dark); color: var(--text-mid);
    border: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
  }
  .tag.green { background: rgba(74,94,58,0.1); border-color: rgba(74,94,58,0.2); color: var(--green-dark); }
  .tag.brown { background: rgba(139,105,20,0.1); border-color: rgba(139,105,20,0.2); color: var(--brown-deep); }

  /* ── EXPERIENCE ── */
  #experience { background: var(--cream); }
  .exp-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4rem; }
  .exp-col-title {
    font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--stone);
    margin-bottom: 2rem; padding-bottom: 0.8rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
  }
  .timeline { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0; }
  .timeline-item { position: relative; padding-left: 1.8rem; padding-bottom: 2.5rem; }
  .timeline-item::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 6px;
    width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--brown-light); border: 2px solid var(--cream);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--brown-light);
  }
  .timeline-item::after {
    content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 20px;
    width: 1px; bottom: 0;
    background: var(--stone-light);
  }
  .timeline-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .timeline-item:last-child::after { display: none; }
  .tl-date {
    font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--stone);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; display: block;
  }
  .tl-role { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--brown-dark); margin-bottom: 0.2rem; }
  .tl-org { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--green-earth); margin-bottom: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; }
  .tl-list { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; }
  .tl-list li {
    font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.6;
    padding-left: 1rem; position: relative;
  }
  .tl-list li::before {
    content: '—'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--brown-light);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
  }

  /* ── EDUCATION ── */
  #education { background: var(--cream-dark); }
  .edu-card {
    background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 2.5rem; max-width: 700px;
    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .edu-card::before {
    content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green-earth), var(--brown-mid));
  }
  .edu-year {
    display: inline-block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500;
    background: rgba(74,94,58,0.1); color: var(--green-earth);
    padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 100px; margin-bottom: 1rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .edu-degree {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brown-dark);
    margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
  }
  .edu-inst { font-size: 1rem; color: var(--green-earth); font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .edu-gpa-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .edu-gpa {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--brown-deep);
  }
  .edu-gpa-label { font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--stone); }
  .edu-thesis {
    background: var(--cream-dark); border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 1rem 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  }
  .edu-thesis-label { font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--stone); margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
  .edu-thesis p { font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text-mid); font-style: italic; }
  .edu-courses { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }

  /* ── ORGANIZATIONS ── */
  #organizations { background: var(--cream); }
  .org-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1.5rem; }
  .org-card {
    background: var(--cream-dark); border: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 1.8rem;
    transition: transform 0.2s;
  }
  .org-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .org-period { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--stone); letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; display: block; }
  .org-name { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--brown-dark); margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
  .org-role { font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--green-earth); margin-bottom: 1rem; font-weight: 500; }
  .org-points { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; }
  .org-points li { font-size: 0.83rem; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.5; padding-left: 1rem; position: relative; }
  .org-points li::before { content: '·'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--brown-light); font-size: 1rem; }
  .cert-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 1rem; margin-top: 2rem; }
  .cert-item {
    background: var(--cream); border: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
    border-radius: 6px; padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
    display: flex; gap: 0.8rem; align-items: flex-start;
  }
  .cert-icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; flex-shrink: 0;
    background: rgba(74,94,58,0.1); border-radius: 4px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  .cert-name { font-size: 0.83rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--brown-dark); line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  .cert-issuer { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--stone); }

  /* ── CONTACT ── */
  #contact { background: var(--green-dark); }
  #contact .section-label { color: var(--green-light); }
  #contact .section-title { color: var(--cream); }
  .contact-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 5rem; align-items: start; }
  .contact-desc { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.8; color: rgba(245,240,232,0.7); margin-bottom: 2.5rem; }
  .contact-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
  .contact-link {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
    padding: 1rem 1.2rem;
    background: rgba(245,240,232,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(245,240,232,0.1);
    border-radius: 6px; text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .contact-link:hover { background: rgba(245,240,232,0.12); transform: translateX(4px); }
  .contact-link-icon {
    width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 6px;
    background: rgba(245,240,232,0.1);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .contact-link-text { }
  .contact-link-label { font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--green-light); margin-bottom: 1px; }
  .contact-link-val { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--cream); }

  .contact-right {
    padding-top: 3.5rem;
  }
  .availability-card {
    background: rgba(245,240,232,0.06); border: 1px solid rgba(245,240,232,0.12);
    border-radius: 8px; padding: 2rem;
  }
  .avail-badge {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    background: rgba(143,168,122,0.2); color: var(--green-light);
    font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 100px; margin-bottom: 1.2rem;
  }
  .avail-badge::before {
    content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--green-light); animation: pulse 2s infinite;
  }
  .avail-card-title { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--cream); margin-bottom: 0.8rem; }
  .avail-card-desc { font-size: 0.88rem; line-height: 1.7; color: rgba(245,240,232,0.6); margin-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .avail-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  .avail-tag {
    font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 100px;
    background: rgba(245,240,232,0.08); color: rgba(245,240,232,0.7);
    border: 1px solid rgba(245,240,232,0.12);
  }

  /* ── FOOTER ── */
  footer {
    background: var(--brown-dark); text-align: center;
    padding: 1.8rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--stone);
  }
  footer a { color: var(--brown-light); text-decoration: none; }

  /* ── ANIMATIONS ── */
  .fade-up {
    opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px);
    transition: opacity 0.6s ease, transform 0.6s ease;
  }
  .fade-up.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

  /* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    nav { padding: 1rem 2rem; }
    .nav-links { display: none; }
    .nav-toggle { display: flex; }
    .nav-links.open {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;
      position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0;
      background: var(--cream); padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--stone-light);
    }
    #hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 100px 2rem 4rem; }
    .hero-right { display: none; }
    section { padding: 4rem 2rem; }
    .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
    .about-left { position: static; }
    .skills-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    .exp-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
    .org-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .cert-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .contact-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3rem; }
    .contact-right { padding-top: 0; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .skills-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- NAV -->
<nav id="navbar">
  <div class="nav-logo">Crespo Fredika</div>
  <ul class="nav-links" id="navLinks">
    <li><a href="#about">Tentang</a></li>
    <li><a href="#skills">Keahlian</a></li>
    <li><a href="#experience">Pengalaman</a></li>
    <li><a href="#education">Pendidikan</a></li>
    <li><a href="#organizations">Organisasi</a></li>
    <li><a href="#contact">Kontak</a></li>
  </ul>
  <div class="nav-toggle" id="navToggle" onclick="toggleNav()">
    <span></span><span></span><span></span>
  </div>
</nav>

<!-- HERO -->
<section id="hero">
  <div class="hero-texture"></div>
  <div class="hero-left">
    <div class="hero-badge">Open to Opportunities</div>
    <h1 class="hero-name">Crespo<br><span>Fredika</span></h1>
    <p class="hero-title">Geotechnical Engineer · Fresh Graduate</p>
    <p class="hero-desc">
      Lulusan Teknik Geologi Institut Teknologi Sumatera. Spesialis analisis kestabilan lereng, mekanika tanah & batuan, serta interpretasi data geoteknik berbasis metode numerik dan limit equilibrium.
    </p>

          Saya adalah fresh graduate Teknik Geologi dari Institut Teknologi Sumatera dengan fokus pada rekayasa geoteknik. Selama masa studi, saya mengembangkan pemahaman mendalam tentang mekanika tanah dan batuan, analisis kestabilan lereng, dan pengolahan data geospasial.
        </p>
        <div class="about-highlight">
          <p>Tugas akhir saya berfokus pada <strong>Mine Slope Stability Analysis</strong> menggunakan <strong>Limit Equilibrium Method</strong> dan <strong>Finite Element Method</strong> — menggabungkan pendekatan analitik dan numerik untuk rekomendasi geometri lereng tambang yang aman.</p>
        </div>
        <p class="about-text">
          Pengalaman magang di dua perusahaan pertambangan memberikan saya pemahaman langsung tentang standar industri, mulai dari korelasi data bor geoteknik, pemodelan kestabilan lereng, hingga analisis potensi longsor berdasarkan regulasi Kepmen ESDM No. 1827.

<script>
  const navbar = document.getElementById('navbar');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    navbar.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 20);
  });

  function toggleNav() {
    document.getElementById('navLinks').classList.toggle('open');
  }

  const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(e => {
      if (e.isIntersecting) {
        e.target.classList.add('visible');
        observer.unobserve(e.target);
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.1, rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px' });

  document.querySelectorAll('.fade-up').forEach(el => observer.observe(el));


</script>
